info.title: Bulk WHOIS Lookup API - Accurate and Efficient Mass Domain Queries
info.description: Retrieve the same real-time WHOIS registration and ownership data as the single-domain WHOIS Lookup API for up to 100 domain names in one request. The response is an object containing a `bulk_whois_response` array in request order; each entry is either a full WHOIS result (registrar, contacts, name servers, status codes, raw WHOIS text) or, if that specific domain's extension is unsupported or the lookup otherwise fails, an error object with `status: false` --- a bad domain in the batch does not fail the whole request. When the batch contains at least one such error alongside successful results, the endpoint returns `206 Partial Content` instead of `200`. Submitting more than 100 domain names returns a `413` error.

servers.description: Bulk Domain WHOIS Lookup API Server

post.summary: Retrieve real-time WHOIS registration and ownership data for up to 100 domain names in a single request
post.description: Returns the current WHOIS record for each requested domain, in request order. Supports up to 100 domain names per request; a domain that fails to resolve yields an error item instead of failing the whole batch.

200.description: WHOIS data retrieved successfully for every requested domain

message.description: Human-readable reason this domain could not be resolved.

status.description: true if this item was successfully processed.

whois_server.description: WHOIS or RDAP server that provided this record.

expiry_date.description: Date the domain registration is set to expire, when the domain is registered.
